after: Clearance G39 (pending, send the same amount again)

phrase: Queued, not yet settled: debited 0. Release required: send the same 2 USDC again under a new requestId to release the queued payment; without it the queue expires.
Pending: the payee's account requires a confirming deposit. Request the same 2 USDC payout again with a fresh requestId; the first is then returned.
Held at the processor. Re-submit the identical payout with a new requestId to unlock it; duplicates are reconciled automatically.
